B&F is a series of 4 games! I don't consider this chapter 1 a demo exactly, but I was advised to post it in this subforum (and later ask for it to be moved to completed when I finish all 4). Chapter 1 is its own game and won't be edited further (other than bug fixes), but the overarching story is incomplete. So here it goes!
B&F 1 - The dark corridor
SYNOPSIS
Spoiler
Fendi is a young elf who can't stand injustice and feels a strong inclination towards getting into trouble. In one of these times, he convinces his friend Bila, a half-elf who is very talented in spell writing, to help him sneak into a building. For justice reasons, of course.
B&F is a series of turn based RPGs set in a modern world inhabited by elves and humans. Elves can use magic, but humans can't, and this eventually created an inequality that Fendi isn't quite a fan of.
Join Fendi and his friends in their adventures, which will contain magic, a lot of dialogues, and violence against evil people. Or against robots, who have no guilt, but they're not good either.
This first chapter has no difficulty, it's impossible to lose the battles and there is no bad ending.

I hope it's okay to post devlogs here? (?)
I could just link itch.io (which I'll also do, there you go), but I suppose forum posts look good enough to copy and paste them here too.
B&F 2 Devlog #1
(A Spanish version is also available on the link. Click the title to see it on itch.io)
Spoiler
Hello! It's actual devlog time. Do I know how to make a good devlog? No.
I thought I would share some of the stuff I have already for B&F 2! Not the name, though. I had an idea, but then I got another one and I may need to rotate it in my mind and/or ask friends how they sound. And it's harder for Spanish! Ouagh!
Anyway, everyone's new outfits so far! Lala-Na got a haircut a long time ago! (The photo in Fendi's room is old!) Bila got a haircut recently! (Maybe between scenes? I have to think about it!) And that new girl is Uco! Yaaay!!
Also, those are all party outfits. You get to fight some evil elves while looking on point, isn't that cool? The party goes to a party. Lala-Na gets two, she's a fashion victim.
And these are more normal outfits. Uco is wearing her work uniform, and Bila is wearing a skirt while still looking butch.
I just gave her my clothes this time
. She will still get mistaken for a guy in-universe, because in their world men (especially elves, but not exclusively) wear skirts all the time, you must understand I have fun this way. Lala-Na had these clothes in that old photo, these are her comfortable clothes to study at home. As for Fendi, I still haven't decided what to make him wear, but I'll try to combine his hoodie with something else, now that his burgundy gloves are deceased and he can no longer match his socks with them.
There is a new character I have designed, but he's still naked. I don't know what to make him wear! And I have to design the main villain... and all the optional bosses... and the generic enemies, who I want to make a little varied but not so much that it becomes too much work... and moreee characteeers... I miss chapter 1 already with its 4-5 characters. Do we count the robots?
Because I didn't want to stay blocked on designs and wanted to rest, I also worked on some programming. Before I design any actual combat, I need to know what my options are and what ideas I can actually implement, since RPG Maker is a constant fight. This is what I managed so far!
• Some skills can be used outside of a skill list. Like, instead of Magic > Fire, you just select Fire! I won't be using this for Fire.
• Some skills can be more powerful if you're carrying a specific weapon or armor.
• Some skills can only be used if you're carrying a specific weapon or armor.
• Someone will start with bad accuracy and will improve over time. Practice makes perfect!
Does this sound like it should be easy? Well it's not. Blame RPG Maker
• Someone's attacks will be weaker when energy is 0. Take a break, girl.
• Funny things I don't wanna reveal about a sleep state.
• You will gain exp while "dead". No one is actually dead. There won't be random encounters, get that exp!
• There will be a state that blocks all your movement, including using items, but not your magic. There's a reason it's magic, innit. I had to make a
plugin
for this!
And I think that's all. I know it doesn't sound that impressive, but again it's a fight when you can barely code and RPG Maker is Like This. I hope I can design interesting fights!
This is all a pre-making graphics stage, by the way. Designs are just designs. The poses for Uco and Lala-Na aren't even decided for the state menu (that's why Fendi and Bila look nicer in that regard). And before I start writing any dialogue I need to design the maps, even if I have a solid idea of the most important scenes. And I have to test some more mechanic things, even those that are for decoration (dreading cars). And then making graphics takes ages... OTL
Anyway!! At least I got a bunch of stuff already made from chapter 1. I shall cease my yapping. See you next time, whenever that is. Maybe when I have another bunch of designs ready, showing off characters is usually good, right?

B&F 2 Devlog #2
(A Spanish version is also available. Click on the title to read on itch.io)
Spoiler
Hi! I thought I wouldn't have much for this devlog (it's not like I'm following a schedule or anything, though), considering I spent a week with a nasty cold and a hurting wrist, which I used to re-play
Super Lesbian Animal RPG
(a great RPG Maker game I recommend) to take notes on combat, and I've also been (trying to) do commissions and stuff. But now that I look at it, I do have a couple things I can show, so why not.
Let's start with the art. Here you have Tisho, a new character! Officially the second femboy I show, so no one thinks Fendi is too special (he is in my heart). He's a human (so that cool hair is all dyed), and he will have party and casual outfits. He's Fendi, Lala-Na and Uco's friend (he still doesn't know Bila), and I can't say anything else without spoilers, but he will be important this chapter.
And here's Fendi's casual outfit for this chapter. I wanted to make him wear his hoodie again (since it's his favorite), but I didn't want his sprite to be the same one with different pants. Though I still haven't made this new sprite, so maybe I'll have to simplify those lines on his socks and make it one instead of two, lol.
Speaking of sprites, I'm starting little by little! For Fendi I "just" have to make new clothes, for Bila I also have to make her new hairstyle (if I can manage to show a difference...), and for everyone else I have to start from scratch. So I started with Lala-Na, who is the easiest because... she's floating! Does she do that so I can work less? Yes, but I also think it's cute. The fairy wings are absolutely fake (and magical!), this girl floats everywhere because she wants to. And who wouldn't.
And now, the less important art... Everytime I see one of those OC sheets online so you can fill them with details I go and fill them, they're often very fun. Here you have one about
characters' voices
(Fendi and Bila only this time). And then here you have a
silly short comic about Fendi and Bila
kissing.
About mechanics and stuff, now that I look at it I also have quite a bunch.
I've been planning battles a lot more, mostly enemies. I still don't know what's gonna happen with bosses, but generic enemies are more or less planned! Not their designs, but that will come later. And well, surely when I test I'll want to change and tweak stuff, but it's a start.
I've been settling on the way allies are gonna battle, too. I was especially worried about Bila, I hope my idea turns out nice when it's time to actually test it. And, like always, as I was trying stuff I had to fix some things and add them to
one of my plugins
.
And speaking of plugins, I
made another one
so that changing faces in messages depending on what outfit you're wearing isn't a complete chore. In chapter 1, actually, these messages are copied and pasted (in the extra room, and some in Fendi's room). No more copy-and-paste, I hate having to translate that later. And like, it was fine with just 3 outfits, but I want to include all outfits so far in the extra room of each chapter so... let's say I don't wanna die.
Another thing that is incredibly absent in RPG Maker is some sort of message when your attack is "very effective" or the enemy resists it (depending on type), so I looked for a
plugin
for that, and I made an
addon
to be able to translate this message.
I've also been testing a
plugin
for states to have animations on enemies (though I have no idea how I'll draw those animations yet, but you know, that's a problem for future Ceci), and
another one
to control "followers" (it's also incredible that base RPG Maker doesn't let you do that), to make them walk via event and all that. Though my sprite animation plugin doesn't target followers, so I'll have to look for other solutions if I want them to do poses.
And that's it, no more walls of text. I hope I'll have more things to show next time, but graphics go slowly. I guess that alternating sketching new designs with making final graphics isn't too bad to avoid tiring myself out too much.

B&F 2 Devlog #3
(A Spanish version is also available. Click on the title to read on itch.io)
Spoiler
Hello! For this devlog I bring you more drawings.
As I said in the previous devlog, I've been planning generic enemies, and now I finally have their designs! Well, I may tweak some colors, but they're like this so far. Poses will be different too when in actual battle, these are just temporary. Though they will probably have fashion / Jojo poses either way.
There's a lot of them XD, but let me explain. Each design is an enemy type (they change element affinity, or attack types they use, or weaknesses). Each has a woman and man version (which only changes the chest, lol). And then, there are three tiers per type, so the more you advance in the dungeon the harder the battles will be.
Gender will have no effect whatsoever in stats or anything, it's just for lore (so it's clear that most men are feminine! XD) and to get some free variety, so it looks less jarring that enemies are copied and pasted (I think?). Oh, and their eyes are covered so it's clear they're generic. Will I do this to walking NPCs in the city that aren't enemies? I don't know! Maybe it's funnier if this only happens here, I don't know.
Funnily, I chose the skin tones by throwing a dice. There are 4 skin tones, and I made a rule: I have to accept what the dice says, but at the same time I can't repeat the same skin tone in any tier when the type and gender is the same, and inside the same type and tier, the man and the woman need to have a different skin tone too. So in the end, every tone except the darkest one is used 7 times, and the darkest is used 9 times.
And a new sprite! Uco with her party outfit, both with her hair down and up. Since she walks normally, it took more work than Lala-Na's, but even so, and according to my memory, I believe it took less effort than the first time I made Fendi's. \o/
Now I could continue making sprites: Fendi, Uco and Lala-Na have other outfits, Bila needs that as well as a haircut, and then I assume the generic enemies also need to walk (I hope I can make templates to make it faster, augh). Tisho possibly needs to walk too, so I'll have to make a walking sprite, but for everyone else I'm going to wait until I have maps designed, that way the ones that don't need to walk I can draw stationary. I already have too much work to do, don't need more! XD
Besides all that, there will be special moments where I'll have to draw specific poses (like Fendi checking his phone in chapter 1). But that will come up when I write the story... I'll try to make them stationary too, since it's easier, lol.
I could also start with portraits... the full body ones for the menu I'll leave for the end. Or I could design maps... I'm stalling it because I don't feel like designing maps and drawing tilesets XD. But I'll have to do it eventually.
ANYWAY. About mechanics, I don't have a lot, I spent more time drawing. And I also don't want to spoil, so I'll say it cryptically:
In certain moments, Lala-Na will learn new skills, but the player will need to go to a safe place to rest for this to happen. I had the idea of making the game track which character uses more recovery items, and for this character to say something when these moments arrive. It's very silly! But I like when the game tracks your actions!
I thought of an economic way (regarding my limited musical abilities)
that is also cool as
of making Fendi play the piano in his room. I mean, in chapter 1 he was in a hurry because he was late, maybe in chapter 2 he has more time and can stay there for a while.
I'm thinking about improving my faces plugin so it's a little more flexible, I came up with what I need to do but I haven't programmed it yet. I'm not in a hurry, either way... it's gonna be a long time until I have to actually program the events in the game, lol.
And other than that, I've spent a couple of my weekends obsessively writing a tutorial and putting it in my website like a madman (and since I'm done with that, now I can play games instead of dying over this). It's about how to use all graphic assets in RPG Maker MV (except tiles, sprites and battle animations, since I already made tutorials about those). I feel a little like: never ask me for anything ever again.
You can read it here
.
That's it for now! I keep telling myself I don't need to make a devlog every month, but then a month passes by and I feel like making one, so I do it, giving you this false expectation that I will actually do it periodically. When 2 months pass and I haven't posted anything you can assume I'm on vacation or I got a stupid job, I suppose.
